The '''MG7 proton torpedo launcher''' was a [[proton torpedo launcher]] developed by the manufacturing company [[Krupx Munitions]].<ref name="SWCT X-wing" /> [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]s were equipped with a pair of MG7 proton torpedo launchers.<ref name="ANH" />
